en.summary: Europe's expert panel recommended approving Lilly's once-a-day weight-loss pill Foundayo. The European Commission still has the final say.

cards.alt:
Lose weight
with a pill?
Lilly's weight-loss pill Foundayo just got a thumbs-up in Europe
Not approved yet: the European Commission has the final say

What just
happened?
Fierce Pharma · Oct 16, 2026
Europe's expert panel recommended approving Lilly's once-a-day weight-loss pill, Foundayo.
A daily pill for obesity and type 2 diabetes, no needles
People lost 5–11% of their weight over 72 weeks (placebo: 2–2.5%)
The European Commission still has to sign off

daily pill

en.title: Chinese biotech: not for sale? Beijing's draft takeover ban
en.summary: Beijing says foreign firms can license its biotech, but not buy it outright. It's still a draft, with comments closing on 15 November.

cards.alt:
Chinese biotech:
not for sale?
Beijing says foreign firms can license its biotech, but not buy it outright
Still a draft: comments close on November 15

What just
happened?
Fierce Biotech · Oct 16, 2026
China proposed a rule: foreign companies can't buy its key biotech platforms outright.
Buying a company with core platforms is off the table
Licensing and contract R&D or manufacturing stay open
It's a draft · comments close Nov 15

Licensing is fine.
Buying isn't.
